description: Frozen authored synthetic bilingual short-memory comparison. All people, facts and projects are fictional. No user data. Created before candidate scoring.

evaluationContract.mixedCorpus: one language per record: zh at even record positions, en at odd positions
evaluationContract.qualityEncoding: single record and single query to avoid dynamic-quantization batch coupling
